subsegment: Onshore wind farm — utility-scale (60-150 turbines, 200-500 MW)
description: Greenfield utility-scale onshore wind project with turbine supply, BOP civil/electrical, collection system, and substation tie-in. Schedule and economics are dominated by PTC/ITC safe-harbor windows and OEM turbine delivery slots.
hard_deadline_themes: FAA obstruction lighting clearance prior to commissioning
PPA commercial operation date (COD) with LDs

typical_risks.description_template: {turbine_oem} nacelle and blade deliveries are sequenced against a global order book; loss of slot pushes erection past the {month} weather window.
Placed-in-service date must precede IRS continuity-of-construction expiry to preserve full PTC value at ${ptc_value}M.
Borings show variable competent rock depth across the {n_turbines}-turbine layout, risking rock excavation overruns at foundation pours.
Regional shortage of 750-ton class crawler cranes and certified turbine erection crews coincides with peer projects in the {region} ISO.
Sustained winds above {wind_threshold} m/s and icing conditions historically suspend blade lifts for {n_days} days through Q1.
Client requests post-NTP micrositing changes to chase {pct} MWh yield improvement, forcing re-permitting of access roads.
USFWS post-construction mortality monitoring may impose curtailment regimes affecting PPA energy delivery.
Main step-up transformer lead time of {weeks} weeks creates schedule float erosion if FAT slips.

typical_issues.description_template: State DOT superload permits for 70m+ blades delayed at county handoff.
Rock pedestal excavation at turbines {ids} exceeded baseline cubic yards.
Sustained winds aloft halted nacelle lifts for {n_days} consecutive shifts.
Medium-voltage collection cable splice QA failures required re-termination on {n_circuits} circuits.
Utility witness test rescheduled, pushing back-feed energisation by {weeks} weeks.
Turbine OEM SCADA points failing PPA real-time telemetry handshake with ISO.
Heavy rain eroded {miles} miles of crane path requiring re-grading prior to walking the crane.
Inadvertent discovery during trenching triggered Section 106 stop-work.
Open punch items on {n_turbines} units threaten substantial completion certificate.

typical_co_drivers: Owner-directed micrositing changes after geotech reveal
Turbine model upgrade mid-execution to higher nameplate
Additional rock excavation beyond baseline at WTG foundations
Utility-requested upgrades to substation protection scheme
Curtailment-driven SCADA logic changes to satisfy avian mitigation

subsegment: Utility-scale PV solar — single-axis tracker (50-200 MW AC)
description: Fixed-price EPC for single-axis tracker PV plants with central or string inverters, MV collection, and gen-tie to a POI substation. Margin is highly sensitive to module/tracker pricing, AD/CVD posture, and ITC milestones.

typical_risks.description_template: Bifacial modules held under UFLPA WRO at port {port}, risking {weeks}-week stacking delay.
Slippage past placed-in-service trigger erodes ITC bonus adders worth ${itc_m}M.
Caliche/rock layers at {pct}% of pile locations cause refusals requiring pre-drill program.
Regional IBEW Local {local_n} hall is short {n_workers} journeymen during peak DC pull.
OSHA heat-illness standards force shortened shifts when wet-bulb exceeds threshold during {month}.
Client pivots from {original_module} to higher-wattage SKU mid-build, requiring stringing redesign.
Sediment discharge from disturbed acreage risks NOV under construction general permit.
ISO updates Order 2023A ride-through requirements after PO, requiring vendor firmware revision.

typical_issues.description_template: Block {block_id} pile refusals require predrill mobilisation.
Container of modules arrived with {n_pallets} pallets damaged.
Early-batch tracker drive motors failing burn-in at {pct}% rate.
QA flagged combiner box polarity errors in {n_boxes} units.
Gen-tie substation structural steel delivery slipped {weeks} weeks.
State environmental agency issued notice of violation for sediment leaving site.
Underground utility strike during DC trenching at row {row_id}.
IV-curve testing identified {n_strings} underperforming strings requiring rework.
Site evacuated for portion of shift due to heat index above threshold.

typical_co_drivers: Module wattage upgrade to capture higher-yield SKU
Predrill program added for refusal-prone blocks
Owner-directed addition of battery DC-coupling provisions
Substation scope expansion for second feeder
Revised stormwater controls to address NOV

description: Diversion-style or low-head run-of-river hydro project with intake, penstock, powerhouse, and tailrace. Schedules are dictated by in-stream work windows and FERC licensing conditions.
hard_deadline_themes: PPA COD with hydrologic season alignment

typical_risks.description_template: Sole-source Francis/Kaplan unit from {oem} has {weeks}-week lead time with limited expediting leverage.
License article requires functional downstream fish passage at COD; testing protocol with USFWS unresolved.
Differing site conditions in dam foundation excavation reveal sheared rock requiring redesigned anchorage.
Specialty underground crews are committed to peer projects; mobilisation premium of {pct}% expected.
Cofferdam overtopping risk during freshet could flood powerhouse excavation for {weeks} weeks.
State fish & wildlife window restricts in-water work to {months}, with no extension mechanism.

typical_risks.category: Client scope on fish ladder design
typical_risks.description_template: Client requests enhanced ladder design to support broader anadromous species, mid-execution.
Reservoir flushing protocol contested by downstream users; could require operational redesign.

typical_issues.description_template: Higher-than-modeled seepage requires supplemental dewatering pumps.
RT inspection flagged {pct}% weld rejection rate on penstock segments.
Runner arrived with surface damage requiring OEM field repair.
Early arrival of monitored species triggered early shutdown of in-water work.
{n_anchors} rock anchors failed proof load and require redrill.
Cold-weather pour resulted in cold joint requiring repair.
Quarterly compliance filing slipped, prompting agency inquiry.
Initial wet commissioning revealed scour patterns requiring riprap augmentation.
Section 106 consultation extended after artifact discovery near intake.

typical_co_drivers: Cofferdam redesign for higher-than-baseline flow
Enhanced fish passage features per agency comment
Differing site conditions in foundation rock
Owner-directed switchyard expansion for second circuit
Additional sediment handling per reservoir management plan

description: Binary-cycle (ORC) geothermal generation with production/injection wellfield tie-ins, gathering system, plant island, and gen-tie. Resource risk and ORC equipment lead times dominate execution planning.
hard_deadline_themes: UIC Class V injection permit conditions

typical_risks.description_template: ORC island package from {oem} has {weeks}-week schedule float with limited domestic alternatives.
Categorical exclusion or EA approval gating gathering-line construction may slip past mobilisation.
Production well wellhead temperatures running {delta}°F below resource report, reducing net output.
Coded welders for high-pressure two-phase piping are in short supply across {region}.
Snow closure of access roads halts gathering pipework for {weeks} weeks of Q1.
Owner explores flash-cycle topping unit late in design, threatening plant layout freeze.
Non-condensable gas content exceeds design basis; H2S scrubbing scope may expand.
Isopentane shipment customs hold could delay plant fill and commissioning.

typical_issues.description_template: Tested wellhead temperature below resource report by {delta}°F.
Two-phase piping welds failing RT at {pct}% rate.
Plant failed vacuum tightness test on first attempt, requiring leak hunt.
NPSH margin lower than designed; vendor redesign required.
Early operations show faster-than-expected silica scaling in heat exchangers.
Utility tie-in outage rescheduled, deferring back-feed.
Stop-work issued for activity outside permitted disturbance area.
Heat trace gap caused condensate freeze damage to instrument line.
Minor pentane leak required area evacuation and seal replacement.

typical_co_drivers: Additional H2S abatement to meet emissions limits
Resource-driven downrating mitigation (added wells or HX surface)
Owner-directed plant layout change for future expansion
Winterisation upgrades after first-season operational learnings
Pipeline reroute to avoid sage-grouse habitat

subsegment: Municipal water/wastewater treatment plant upgrade (10-80 MGD)
description: Brownfield modernisation or expansion of a municipal WTP/WWTP including biological treatment, filtration, disinfection, and SCADA. Delivered against consent decree or NPDES schedules with tight tie-in windows on a live plant.
hard_deadline_themes: EPA LT2 or DBP rule compliance deadlines

typical_risks.description_template: {tech_pkg} package is sole-sourced via {oem} with {weeks}-week lead time and pre-purchase exposure.
EPA/state consent decree imposes hard placed-in-service date with stipulated penalties of ${k}k/day.
Record drawings inaccurate for brownfield site; yard piping conflicts likely during excavation.
Specialty process mechanical and instrument crews competing with peer water projects in {region}.
Tie-ins to active basins require coordinated bypass with peak-flow season constraint.
Heavy rainfall events overwhelm temporary bypass capacity, suspending tie-in work.
New EPA PFAS MCLs may require scope addition for GAC or IX polishing post-NTP.
Client operations staff turnover risks delayed acceptance testing and beneficial use.

typical_issues.description_template: Excavation struck unmapped {utility_type} requiring emergency repair.
Wet weather event exceeded temporary bypass capacity, triggering SSO notification.
Basin leak test failed; epoxy injection repair required.
Membrane skids failed initial FAT, requiring vendor rework before shipping.
Legacy PLC integration revealed protocol mismatches delaying functional testing.
Asbestos pipe insulation discovered during demolition of original works.
State agency added supplemental sampling requirement mid-construction.
Chlorine residual targets not met during startup; recirculation extended.
Utility outage exceeded planned window, damaging in-service drives.

typical_co_drivers: PFAS treatment addition per evolving regulation
Differing subsurface conditions / unmapped utilities
Owner-directed SCADA platform standardisation
Additional bypass pumping for wet-weather events
Hazmat abatement scope (asbestos / lead paint)

description: Coastal SWRO plant including intake (open or subsurface), pretreatment, RO trains, post-treatment, brine outfall, and product delivery. Permitting around marine impacts and energy intensity are dominant constraints.

typical_risks.description_template: Membrane and pressure exchanger packages effectively sole-sourced from {oem}; price/lead-time exposure significant.
State coastal authority may impose subsurface intake requirement increasing scope by ${m}M.
Microtunnel for intake/outfall encounters cobble/boulder strata not in baseline borings.
Specialty marine spread (jack-up, microtunneling crew) has narrow availability window.
Offshore work limited to {months} due to sea state; storm season slips intake completion.
Owner reconsiders membrane vendor for lifecycle cost reasons mid-design.
Regulators require expanded mixing-zone modeling, potentially expanding diffuser scope.
Energy cost escalation passes through to LCOW; PPA hedging exposure remains with owner but stresses schedule.

typical_issues.description_template: TBM encountered boulder/clog requiring intervention shaft.
Sea-state exceeded vessel limits for {n_days} days.
Initial diffuser sinking attempt aborted; second mobilisation required.
Pretreatment underperformance fouled first train requiring CIP and rework.
Rapid biofouling on intake screens reduced flow during testing.
Weld discolouration on duplex piping required additional PMI and rework.
Agency added entrainment monitoring scope mid-construction.
Utility tie-in outage exceeded planned window.
Initial hydrostatic test on outfall failed acceptance.

typical_co_drivers: Conversion to subsurface intake per coastal commission ruling
Expanded diffuser/outfall scope from mixing-zone modeling
Differing subsea geotechnical conditions during microtunneling
Owner-directed energy recovery device upgrade
Pretreatment scope expansion (DAF/UF) to address algal events

subsegment: Large-diameter water conveyance / transmission main (48"-120", 5-40 miles)
description: Linear infrastructure delivering raw or treated water across long alignments via steel/PCCP/RCP pipe, with pump stations, tunnels, and crossings. Right-of-way, permits, and tunneling productivity dominate the risk profile.

typical_risks.description_template: Domestic AWWA C200/C301 pipe mills booked through {quarter}; substitution risks Buy America compliance.
DOT/railroad crossing permits with {n_crossings} agencies in series may slip critical path.
Borings limited; karst/cobble/contaminated soils possible across {miles}-mile alignment.
Microtunneling and large-diameter pipelayer crews limited regionally during peak season.
Saturated soils suspend open-cut for {weeks} weeks; trench dewatering scope grows.
Owner shifts alignment to accommodate landowner negotiations, triggering re-permitting.
Inadvertent discovery during trenching may require monitor-mandated stop-work.
Hydrostatic testing fails on segments due to joint workmanship requiring expose-and-repair.

typical_issues.description_template: Landowner refused entry causing detour design at MP {mp}.
Trench rock encountered exceeding baseline cubic yards.
Microtunnel face encountered running sand requiring grouting.
Test segment failed pressure test, requiring localised expose-and-repair.
Railroad crossing permit slipped, deferring boring activity.
Petroleum-impacted soil discovered along legacy industrial corridor.
Coating damage from handling required field repair on {n_joints} joints.
Sediment migration triggered notice of violation under construction stormwater permit.
Archaeological monitor halted trenching pending evaluation.

typical_co_drivers: Alignment change to resolve easement holdout
Differing subsurface conditions (rock/contaminated soil)
Owner-directed pipe material change (PCCP to steel)
Added bore-and-jack at agency-mandated crossing
Cultural resource mitigation scope additions

description: Brownfield modernisation of an integrated or mini-mill, typically EAF replacement, caster upgrade, or hot-strip line revamp. Executed within tight production outage windows with significant tie-in to live operations.
hard_deadline_themes: EPA Title V air permit modification deadlines

typical_risks.description_template: Process technology supplier ({oem}) provides proprietary equipment with no alternative; FAT slippage threatens outage.
EPA Title V permit modification for new EAF emissions point may slip past mechanical completion.
As-found foundations, refractory chases, and embedded utilities differ from record drawings.
Outage window coincides with regional turnaround season, driving labour premiums.
Heavy lifts of EAF shell/caster modules wind-restricted during winter outage.
Owner adds scope into outage window late, compressing critical path.
Ramp-up to nameplate may stretch beyond contract acceptance, triggering performance LDs.
Refractory dryout sequence requires uninterrupted gas supply that conflicts with site outage planning.

typical_issues.description_template: Owner-directed scope additions extended outage by {days} days.
Sustained winds delayed shell setting by {days} days.
Burner availability constraints delayed dryout completion.
As-found rebar congestion required redesign of new anchor pattern.
Particulate ingress during commissioning required system flush.
Overhead crane outage conflicts created lift sequencing rework.
Legacy L2 system integration delays automated startup.
Initial performance test below guarantee on throughput; tuning extended.
Hand injury during refractory work generated OSHA recordable.

typical_co_drivers: Owner-added scope folded into outage window
Differing as-found conditions in foundations and utilities
Acceleration directives to recover outage schedule
Air permit-driven baghouse upsizing
Additional automation upgrades requested for production ramp

description: Greenfield or major-expansion specialty chemicals facility with reactor trains, separation, utilities, and tank farm. Process safety (PSM/RMP), licensor IP integration, and commissioning sequencing govern delivery.

typical_risks.description_template: Process licensor controls reactor internals and catalyst loading procedures; schedule depends on their field reps.
State air construction permit and RMP review may not align with mechanical completion.
Brownfield site has historic contamination requiring management plan during excavation.
Coded pipe fitters and instrument techs constrained by Gulf Coast turnaround season.
Plant location in hurricane zone risks tank-farm and structural module stand-down during season.
Owner pivots product mix mid-FEED, forcing reactor and feed-system redesign.
Process Hazard Analysis closure items pile up at commissioning, blocking startup.
Catalyst lot from {oem} requires specialised handling and arrives near loading window.

typical_issues.description_template: Modular skid alignment discrepancies required field rework at tie-in.
Reactor feed line failed hydrotest, requiring weld repair and re-PWHT.
Contaminated soil encountered required offsite disposal.
PSI/PHA action item closures slipped, deferring readiness review.
Loop checks revealed wiring errors in {n_loops} loops.
Tropical storm forced site standdown and module securing.
Late design change required Title V permit modification.
Initial product runs off-spec; tuning extended commissioning.
Pre-startup safety review identified gaps in MOC documentation.

typical_co_drivers: Owner product slate / capacity change
Permit-driven equipment additions (flare, scrubber, RTO)
Differing brownfield subsurface conditions
Module rework following dimensional control issues
Acceleration to meet customer first-product commitment

subsegment: Combined-cycle gas turbine plant (500-1100 MW, 1x1 or 2x1)
description: Greenfield or repower CCGT with F-class or H-class gas turbines, HRSGs, steam turbine, ACC or wet cooling, and gas/water interconnects. Interconnection queue, gas tap, and emissions permits dominate schedule logic.
hard_deadline_themes: ISO/RTO interconnection in-service date with capacity auction tie-in
EPA NSR/PSD and state air permit milestones
FERC tariff and gas pipeline in-service date

typical_risks.description_template: GT/ST trains from {oem} are slotted globally; loss of slot extends in-service date by {months} months.
PSD/NSR permit conditions on NOx/CO and startup emissions may require SCR/CO catalyst resizing.
Variable bearing capacity may force pile foundation redesign for heavy equipment pads.
HRSG erection and large-bore piping crews are constrained by peer CCGT and LNG projects.
Outdoor heavy lifts and HRSG module setting are weather-restricted during {season}.
Network upgrades by transmission owner are not contractually owned but gate back-feed and synchronisation.

typical_risks.category: Owner change in gas supply config
typical_risks.description_template: Owner explores dual-fuel or hydrogen-blend provisions late, affecting BOP design.
Heat-rate and capacity guarantees with significant LDs require precise commissioning and ambient correction.

typical_issues.description_template: Module arrived with shipping damage requiring on-site repair.
GSU transformer failed factory test, deferring delivery {weeks} weeks.
High-pressure steam piping weld rejection above benchmark.
Transmission owner's network upgrade slipped, deferring back-feed.
Pipeline tap-in by interstate operator slipped, deferring fuel-in.
Emissions tuning extended commissioning due to ambient swings.
Sustained cold halted concrete and outdoor lifts for {days} days.
Rigging incident during heavy lift generated OSHA recordable.
Reliability run interrupted by aux equipment trip, restarting clock.

typical_co_drivers: Network upgrade / interconnection scope changes
Air permit-driven SCR/CO catalyst sizing increases
Owner-directed dual-fuel or H2-blend provisions
Acceleration directives to preserve capacity auction commitment
Differing site conditions requiring pile foundations
